title: Composio & Agent Handler Tools
summary: This module provides specialized tools for integrating CrewAI agents with Composio actions and Merge Agent Handler, enabling secure and structured interaction with a wide array of third-party applications and services.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: An autonomous entity within the CrewAI framework that orchestrates tasks, makes decisions, and utilizes available tools to achieve its objectives.

nodes.label: Composio Tool Wrapper
nodes.title: ComposioTool
nodes.description: Enables CrewAI agents to execute specific actions provided by the Composio platform. It handles the conversion of Composio action schemas into a format usable by CrewAI and ensures necessary authentication checks.

nodes.label: Merge Agent Handler Tool
nodes.title: MergeAgentHandlerTool
nodes.description: Facilitates secure interaction between CrewAI agents and various third-party integrations through the Merge Agent Handler. It manages API requests, authentication, and permissions using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

nodes.label: Composio Platform
nodes.title: Composio Platform
nodes.description: An external integration platform that offers a wide array of pre-built actions for connecting to different applications and services, which can be leveraged by CrewAI agents.

nodes.label: Merge Agent Handler API
nodes.title: Merge Agent Handler API
nodes.description: The central API for the Merge Agent Handler, responsible for receiving Model Context Protocol (MCP) requests from agents, authenticating them, and securely routing them to the appropriate third-party services.

nodes.label: Third-Party Services
nodes.title: Third-Party Services
nodes.description: Various external applications, APIs, and systems (e.g., CRM, project management, communication tools) that are integrated and accessed indirectly through the Composio platform or Merge Agent Handler.

groups.label: CrewAI Core
groups.title: CrewAI Core
groups.description: The central intelligent agent component that initiates and utilizes the tools.

groups.label: Tool Implementations
groups.title: Tool Implementations
groups.description: Core components that define how CrewAI agents interact with external platforms and services.

groups.label: External Integration Platforms
groups.title: External Integration Platforms
groups.description: Represents the external services and APIs that provide the underlying functionality for the tools.
